label: Physarum Lagrangian
plain: Explore the veins of a multinucleate plasmodium. Look inside a vein and follow the same parcel through a reversal of shuttle streaming.

modelled.text: Physarum Lagrangian is a planned Cells model. This 3D atlas shows the organism and illustrates shuttle streaming.

levels.label: Plasmodium
levels.shows: A branching network with thick veins and thin advancing regions.

levels.label: Vein cutaway
levels.shows: The contractile wall, streaming cytoplasm and a parcel that can be followed through a flow reversal.

network.text: Alim et al. (2013). Random network peristalsis in Physarum polycephalum organizes fluid flows across an individual.
